FN-SLVTT85-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 174
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 174 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State Oil and Gas Board by
an undetermined amount to regulate the establishment and operation of alternative energy
facilities. Any increase in obligations would be offset, wholly or partly, by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the amount of fees set by the board and deposited into the
Alabama State Oil and Gas Board Special Fund, for the purpose of defraying the expenses of
regulating alternative energy facilities .
In addition, the provisions of this bill could also increase receipts to the Department of
Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
amount of funds received for the lease of lands under the jurisdiction of DCNR for the
exploration, development, and production of other energy sources and for related uses, as
allowed by this act.
